text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has assessed an appeal from the owner of 160B Cedric Avenue for front yard parking. Front yard parking at this location is not recommended because it does not meet the criteria of the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 918 in that the Code does not permit the licensing of a front yard parking pad where on-street permit parking is authorised on the same side of the street. Additionally, the Code does not permit the licensing of a front yard parking pad where the poll was negative. The owner will be given an opportunity to make a deputation before Community Council.
North York Community Council: 1. Deferred consideration of the item until its meeting on July 4, 2018.
